cohort: A G2P1 female at 34 4/7 weeks pregnancy with abdominal pain.
finding: A ruptured right internal iliac pseudoaneurysm was diagnosed in a pregnant woman at 34 4/7 weeks gestation and managed with concurrent caesarian delivery and pseudoaneurysm coiling.
mod_finding: Primary caesarian delivery was performed concurrently with vascular surgery for pseudoaneurysm coiling due to the ruptured pseudoaneurysm.
